full_judgment: 3. The main ground on which the defendant No. 1 entered the contest was that the plaintiff was not entitled to recover rent from the defendants inasmuch as his interest, being that of a "lent receiver", within the meaning of sub-section (23) of section 2 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, had vested in the Government under provisions of the said Act.
